decision.observation: 5 mph, gear 1, all dots pale. The short W+A cost 7 mph (12 to 5) but left the car centred on a wide gravel straight that runs up-frame and bends left past pines and a boulder cluster on the right, lake glimpsed upper-left. A small red icon and faint '+5.5'-like text sit just left of the timer.
decision.hypothesis: Once again steering was expensive even for 0.8 s. The car is now centred with a long clear straight ahead, so plain throttle is the right move; the '+5.5' text may be a time delta worth watching.
decision.memory: Steering cost on this lake-side straight: 12->5 mph for a 0.8 s W+A. Vague '+5.5'-like text beside the timer recurred — second sighting of a possible split/penalty readout, still unreadable against the frozen clock.
